title: Indicator of the inner-product-one set
statement: For every natural number $m$, identify a vector $z\in(\mathbf F_2)^{2m}$ with a pair $(u,v)$ of vectors in $(\mathbf F_2)^m$, and let $u\cdot v$ be their dot product over $\mathbf F_2$. The indicator function of the set of such $z$ for which $u\cdot v=1$ is the real-valued function that takes value $1$ when $u\cdot v=1$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: the functions are defined on $(\mathbf F_2)^{2m}$
